summary.text: Mark Noland is a Republican member of the Montana State Senate representing District 6 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, he previously served in the Montana House of Representatives from 2015 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Mark Noland was born in Whitefish, Montana, lives in Bigfork, and graduated from Whitefish High School.
His career experience includes working as a business owner.
Noland represented Montana House District 10 from 2015 to 2023 before joining the State Senate.
In the 2025-2026 session, he chaired the Business, Labor and Economic Affairs Committee and was also assigned to the Fish and Game and Natural Resources committees.
